notes.title: 💨 Beta Ain’t Ready! But We’re Still Goin’ FULL SAIL! ⛵
notes.content:
[h1]🏴‍☠️ Ahoy there, gamer crew! Ye better batten down the hatches, cause we’ve been workin like mad pirates in a code storm![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/5b63519bc0e37f55aaa24eaf0188cd84f99a6e22.png"][/img][/p][p]🪢 Craftin' systems? Check! Custom loot? Double check! And modular pirate vehicles that look like they were dreamt up in a fever fueled dream? Ohhh, we got those too!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/49da71ca66d2a125495953cc5cf4e45d42f2be9f.png"][/img][/p][p]🧥 We’ve added crafting, gear, clothing and vehicles that’d make even a kraken jealous! From buildin’ wild contraptions to stackin’ yer loot, the game’s gettin’ juicier than a barrel of salty-soaked coconuts! But don’t ye be thinkin’ we’re done yet! There’s still some magic brewin’ below deck. We’re buildin’ tweakin’ and makin’ this beast of a game seaworthy![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/b00a368fac838bf19c0d69ae0a9afdc42984cc5b.png"][/img][/p][p]⛵ We’re sailin’ straight toward open beta testing, and it’s comin’ faster than a cannonball in a tavern brawl! Just a couple more blue moons, and ye might be among the first to set foot on all the Islands! So what’s next, ye ask? This be a sneak peek at the WILD ride ahead, with construction chaos, cannon-blastin' fun, and more voxel madness than Davy Jones can handle![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/ea77011c94fdf86d9759025b1652bac477ae3798.png"][/img][/p][p]🧜‍♀️ So what are ye waitin’ for, ya brave sea dogs?! This ain’t just any island, This is Battle Island, forged in fire, built with voxels, and soaked in glory! If ye be tired of the same old grind, if yer heart beats for chaos, loot, and cannon-blastin’ madness, then hoist yer colors and join us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/42b577e91132133ce755dcffcebbbb572158b2d3.png"][/img][/p][p]🗣️ Wishlist us on Steam. Join the Discord crew. Follow the journey. And prepare to test yer mettle in open beta! We be just two devs, but we’ve built a world that refuses to be ignored, a world that screams ADVENTURE, and kicks you in the loot chest when you least expect it! So sharpen yer swords, load the cannons, and slap on yer fanciest eye patch! Because the tide’s risin’ fast, and Battle Island waits for no one![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/078023377c07da3bc80a04b406ad7bbac2c330e6.png"][/img][/p][p]🧜‍♂️ This be your chance, to leave yer mark, or be left in the sand. We ain't just buildin’ a game, WE'RE LAUNCHIN' A LEGEND! Open beta’s comin’ fast, and trust me, ye won’t want to miss the BOOM![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/399940f06a182210cef54b1b6ab35a934db9be23.png"][/img][/p][p]⚠️ Visuals, performance, and mechanics be subject to change as we steer toward open beta.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="TxIp7TB8kU4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 🕹️ is Coming to the Steam Deck 🎮
notes.content:
🧭 YAARRGH! Battle Island! is officially coming to the Steam Deck! That’s right, soon you'll be able to take your co-op skeleton slaying, island defending, treasure digging adventures on the go! Whether you’re on a long voyage or just lounging in port, the full pirate experience will now fit in your hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/920aa041f7fab8163e6be8773ca90b63807d15d7.gif[/img]

🏴‍☠️ What to Expect:
[list]
[*] Seamless performance and optimized controls for the Steam Deck.
[*] Full support for co-op multiplayer, crafting, mining, and wave based skeleton combat.
[*] A perfect fit for bite sized raids or epic build sessions.
[*] Treasure hunting from the comfort of your hammock!
[/list]

🔧 Under the Hood
We’re currently testing and optimizing the game to make sure it runs smoothly on Valve’s handheld powerhouse. The stylized visuals and sandbox gameplay feel right at home on the Deck and we're loving the results so far!

🎥 Want to see it in action?
We’ll be sharing gameplay footage, updates, and behind the scenes progress on our YouTube Channel, so be sure to subscribe and stay in the loop!

🏗️ Thank you for supporting us on this journey. With your help, YAARRGH! Battle Island! is becoming a game you can enjoy anywhere you go. Keep your blades sharp and your cannons ready, the skeleton horde doesn’t stand a chance!

🏝️ See ye on the island, Deck pirates!

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 🏴‍☠️ Meet Captain Ginger Beard: Tales from the High Seas!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=obELPZZhMuo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Cap'n Ginger Beard[/h1] be a swashbucklin', plunderin', craftin', and fightin' son of a salty dog, with more tales to tell than stars in the sky! Some say he were hatched from an egg atop a mountain, but such tales be naught but fanciful yarns spun by landlubbers and fools!

Nay, the truth be far more fantastical! Cap'n Ginger Beard were not born, but fashioned from the very stuff of legend—a single polygon plucked from the ether, molded by the hands of fate into the fearsome pirate ye see afore ye today!

So, hoist yer Jolly Roger high, me hearties, and prepare to embark on a voyage filled with adventure, treasure, and the legend of Cap'n Ginger Beard! 🏴‍☠️

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! Me Matey!
notes.content:
[h3]🚢 Ahoy, me hearties![/h3] Dive into the briny depths of mystery as we unveil the secrets behind YAARRGH!, the voxel game that's been simmering in our pirate cove for years! Join us on this swashbuckling journey where we answer the age-old questions: What be these YAARRGH! videos all about? What in the seven seas are ye watchin'? Most crucially, do ye even give a care?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/13509e1270e2bf40323d8b8854d64b74f306fba4.gif[/img]

[h3]⚔️ Embark on an epic adventure:[/h3] As we navigate the development seas, from the very first prototype in 2016 to the rebuilt voxel engine in 2023 and the thrilling emergence of YAARRGH! as a fully-fledged game. Pirates, monsters, and uncharted islands await ye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/d8d7c2faaee99988101b82f59c0fe64d65d1d4b9.png[/img]

[h3]🎥 Sit Back, Relax, and Enjoy:[/h3] Answer the call, join our crew, and savor the rest of the video. The sea awaits, and so does the excitement!

[previewyoutube=Gqza41zNxKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🌊 Highlights:[/h3]

🧭 Unveiling the initial prototype in 2016: Creatures of the deep, monsters, and the pursuit of a sea- 
     smooth voxel world with AI.

🧭 Setting sail in 2020 with YAARRGH! Battle Island: Testing multiplayer and networking for a game that 
     plays well with others.

🧭 Navigating the pandemic seas in 2021: Recovering health, operational capabilities, and our 
     determination to craft YAARRGH!

🧭 Reforging the voxel engine in 2023: Harder, better, faster, stronger, sailing natively on the Steam Deck.

🧭 In the year 2024: A new era dawns, where a prototype becomes a game! Explore, mine, craft, and 
     build with yer crew, facing skeleton hordes to secure valuable island resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/ad974e44630513e7b11d9783516ef5604edbb840.png[/img]

[h3]⚓ Call to Arms:[/h3] Will ye join our crew, share in the adventure, and grow with us? Hoist the Jolly Roger and embark on this epic voyage!

notes.title: 🌱 Explore a World of Voxel Wonders! 🌍
notes.content:
🔍 Uncover Procedural Beauty: Delve into the heart of our gaming universe, where every corner reveals a new surprise. Our procedural world-building technology ensures that no two landscapes are alike, guaranteeing an endless array of unique environments for you to discover.

⛏️ Craft Your Path: Embrace the spirit of exploration and creativity as you shape the world around you. With intuitive tools and limitless possibilities, you can build, modify, and transform the terrain, creating your own mark on this vibrant voxel canvas.

📽️ Witness the Magic: Curious to see the enchantment for yourself? Watch our latest testing build video on YouTube to catch a glimpse of the wonders that await. 

[previewyoutube=ohLZQU_y9oQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Join us on this epic journey as we continue to shape our gaming universe. ✨
[h1]☠️ YAARRGH![/h1]
